purpose: Manifest of language packs (§53 Stage 2 + Stage 3 — proof of engine reuse). A pack makes a language BETA (starter reference content) — never PRODUCTION. PRODUCTION requires a full reviewed course (lessons + practice + quiz + review) passing QA in real Chromium; today only Hindi has that.
policy: PRODUCTION = full course with browser QA. BETA = authored starter pack rendering through the shared engines. PLANNED = registered language with no authored content yet.

packs.name: Bengali
packs.scope: Starter pack: beginner vocabulary + phrases + grammar reference, authored and checked. No lesson pages, no audio, no quizzes, no review course — this is NOT a full course and NOT PRODUCTION.
packs.honestNote: BETA proof of engine reuse. Not PRODUCTION: Hindi is the only production language. This is starter reference content only — not a course.
